description: Bernoulli gate: each gate arriving is sent at random to one of two outputs, with the odds set by CHANCE

params.text: Sets the odds, from every gate going to OUTPUT A at one end of the travel to every gate going to OUTPUT B at the other, and an even split in the middle
LATCH holds the chosen output high until a toss comes out differently; the centre position passes the input gate to the chosen output; TOGGLE changes output only when a toss differs from the last

inputs.text: A rising edge here makes a fresh toss, and the length of the gate sets how long the chosen output stays high
Shifts the odds towards OUTPUT B, added to the CHANCE setting; 10V is enough to send every gate to B with CHANCE fully anticlockwise

outputs.text: Carries a 10V gate on every toss that falls its way; with CHANCE fully anticlockwise every gate comes out here
Carries a 10V gate on every toss that falls its way; with CHANCE fully clockwise every gate comes out here

notes: the red and green lamps show which of the two outputs the last toss chose

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
